## Services
Cenk operates as a single-person studio offering three focused services:

1. SaaS Development — full-stack product builds from idea to paying customers.
   Stack: React, TypeScript, Supabase / Postgres, Stripe, OpenAI, Vercel.
   Page: https://vcenkkarakuz.com/services/saas-development

2. Web Development — marketing sites and landing pages built with React + Tailwind.
   Focus: performance, accessibility, conversion, SEO.
   Page: https://vcenkkarakuz.com/services/web-development

3. n8n Automation — workflow automation systems for lead handling, AI content
   pipelines, reporting, and CRM operations.
   Page: https://vcenkkarakuz.com/services/n8n-automation

## Engagement model
- Discovery call to scope the work
- Fixed quote with weekly demos in a staging environment
- Production deploy with documentation and 30 days of post-launch support
- Currency: CAD (USD or EUR negotiable for international clients)
- Pricing: per-project, no retainers required. Contact for a quote.

## Service area
Primary market: Vancouver, BC, and the rest of Canada.
Remote work: worldwide for clients in compatible time zones.
